payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and metrics used to evaluate the quality of the data, including manual inspections and statistical measures.

claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated through manual inspections of translations with low scores, which are sent back for revision.
Quality is also assessed using similarity scores between transcripts and translations based on cross-lingual sentence embeddings.
The evaluation includes calculating average BLEU scores and model stability against different speakers to assess output variance.
